boundary: The guard set and proof grammar are unchanged; this execution variant keys class memoization by exact RBA words plus guard mask/horizon and keys templates by support only.

The pinned RBA authority is descended from the qualified neutral-token quotient: ownership of cells outside all still-possible winning lines is already erased by RBA and is not reintroduced by this key.
The RBA basis is support-determined and therefore omitted from the memo key; the maintained cofactor basis/support equality is separately tested in the pinned authority.
No new response type is introduced: all candidates belong to previously frozen CPC response, guard-renewal, support-lift, or top-debt theorems.
Top-debt repair retains the existing premise that at least one carried guard survives trigger and response untouched.
Acceptance is a constructive survival lower certificate only; rejection is not an attacker upper bound.
